text: 人民银行上海总部召开自贸离岸债业务推进会，总结试点一年来建设成效，研究部署下阶段重点工作，推动自贸离岸债业务高质量发展。 会议通报了自贸离岸债试点以来运行情况，并就FTU投资、商业银行承销、内保外贷等市场关切问题开展政策解读。经过一年多实践探索，自贸离岸债制度框架基本成型，发行主体多元拓展，二级市场交易顺利落地，市场实现良好开局。截至目前，共发行22单自贸离岸债，发行规模约86亿元人民币。
text_en: The Shanghai Head Office of the People's Bank of China held a promotion meeting on free trade offshore bond business, summarizing the construction achievements of the pilot program over the past year, studying and deploying key work for the next stage, and promoting the high-quality development of free trade offshore bond business. The meeting reported on the operation of the free trade offshore bond pilot since its launch and provided policy interpretations on market concerns such as FTU investment, commercial bank underwriting, and domestic guarantee for overseas loans. After more than a year of practical exploration, the institutional framework for free trade offshore bonds has basically taken shape, issuers have diversified, secondary market trading has been successfully implemented, and the market has achieved a good start. As of now, a total of 22 free trade offshore bonds have been issued, with an issuance scale of about 8.6 billion yuan.
